label: Trolley pilot: principles against the triad and loop, and senses of wholly good for Rowe
summary: Typed trolley frame (causal graphs, death counts, plans, object classification) with six principles as Lean definitions; every verdict is computed by reachability. Act consequentialism is excluded by the footbridge and by the transplant verdict (two conditional refutations sharing the verdict-warrant dependency); the KILLS_1 no-killing deontology by the switch verdict; the KILLS_2 reading escapes. Classical double effect, intention-only double effect, the Kantian MEANS_1 principle and the redirection principle each entail the common triad and are jointly satisfiable with all case facts. Loop: classical double effect and the means principle forbid it through causal condition 3 (MEANS_1), not intention; intention-only double effect permits it only on Kamm's plan reading and is then exposed to closeness (control 2); redirection permits it on causal structure and ignores intention (malicious switcher, control 3). Rowe: WHOLLY_GOOD_1 with the open outcome bridge yields STMT-ROWE-PERMISSION-CONSTRAINT (new conditional support option); WHOLLY_GOOD_2 yields only a constraint-qualified condition, with easy rescue retained; WHOLLY_GOOD_3 (ontological goodness plus good-willing) yields neither. Best surviving rival to classical double effect at matching scope: the redirection principle, price: intention irrelevant to permissibility. Details in docs/notes/trolley-principles.md.
blocker: Verdicts remain prima facie premises; the debunking objection's evidence and the loop verdict's warrant are unassessed. Transfer from human intervening to divine permitting is owned by #1456, and the bearer bridge from the case GOD_4 to Rowe's WhollyGood by #1735. The outcome bridge is open (aggregation of lesser costs). The frame does not separate footbridge from transplant.
